models.title: Tombstone sign
models.blurb: Song-request tombstone sign in the poster look: eyebrow, Creepster title, the ghost-with-poppy, a QR code, the scan line, the site and the show times raised in up to eight colours, printed face up; two pockets in the bottom edge take the separately printed stake.

models.title: Tombstone stake
models.blurb: Ground stake for the tombstone sign: a flat blade with a 45-degree point and a flared head whose two tenons fit the sign's pockets; optional cross-pin and half-lapped cross-bar.

params.label: Length
params.description: Tip to tenon ends: the whole printed length.

params.name: thickness
params.label: Thickness
params.description: Match the sign's thickness: the tenons are sized from it.

params.name: retention
params.label: Retention
params.description: 'pin' drills the sign's 3.2 mm cross-hole through each tenon; needs thickness >= 7.8 mm.

models.title: Label card
models.blurb: Slide-in label card for the spool cradle label holder: your text in a fixed font, autoscaled and centred. Inlaid two-colour (face down, flush) or raised single-colour.

models.title: Cup lid holder (Multibuild)
models.blurb: Planar circular-segment cradle with mirrored arc tabs, inward lips and cone locating pins with adjustable interference. Standing print; recessed tapered seat and flat shoulder match the measured bolt head, pending physical validation.

models.title: Spool cradle (Multibuild)
models.blurb: Single spool bookshelf cradle with wide inboard saddle rails, outboard placement guides (omitted when reach is less than 2.4 mm plus saddle clearance) and closed truss webs, in three mount styles: two full-height Multiconnect channels (channel), four MultiBuild Fix Point slots in two rows 50 mm apart, lip end up (points), or four openConnect slots for an openGrid wall on the 28 mm tile pitch and 84 mm cadence, two under the plate top and two at the lowest tile that keeps the bottom floor (openconnect). A slide-in label card holder on the front panel (spool width 63.4 mm and up; swap the card with the spool out). Flange-rim support; standing PETG/PCTG print with support allowed only in the mount pockets.

models.title: openConnect drawer
models.blurb: mitufy's openConnect drawer (CC BY-SA 4.0): shell, container and stopper clips. The shell prints back-wall-down with a honeycomb bottom, selectable wall types and any mounting face; the container prints bottom-down with a handle, label holder (clipped to the body when wider than the front) and magnet pockets. Comma-separated compartment lists add shell dividers (one container per compartment) or container dividers; the clips print flat.

params.name: label_width

presets.label: 5 × 2 × 5 shell split 3 + 2 tiles wide; build a 3- and a 2-wide container

By Hands on Katie and BlackjackDuck, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (non-commercial, share-alike). Prints as shown, closed face down, no supports.
